name: Impaso: The Lost Artist
summary:
Even you can become a great artist! 

ARTIST SIMULATOR
"Impaso: The Lost Artist" is an artist simulator experience with a light story and progression. You play as a clockwerk artist who begins in a back alley, selling art on the streets and progressing toward building your own grand Gallery!

PAINT AND SELL ART
You can just paint anything, selling your art, take commissions, and progress at your own pace through the 4-act Story
